a.lede: Google attempted to take its Chromebook platform upscale with Googlebooks. But the timing could not have been worse. Phone support at launch is extremely limited, and most people use Android phones and Chromebooks because they’re cheap.
a.title: Googlebooks are as poorly timed as Valve’s Steam Machine, and may suffer a similar fate

b.lede: Android laptops are here, but Google has a lot of work ahead to make them good.
b.title: Googlebook review: Android on a laptop is still Android
